comment: Line turns about 5 degrees at the crossing of the 1.0 in and 0.01 s grid lines: straight arms (du/dv 1.04 below, 0.88 above, each about 200 px long) meet at about (2060,3287), 4 px from P; the rate eases as the note says. Turn is subtle but visible on a 4x crop spanning both arms; P on ink.

Corner of the bend (tangent fits and strongest curvature) at about (1237,3480): Q 6 px, P 17 px. P sits lower, where the line separates from the dashed 0 line at the onset of the bend, still within about 15 degrees of vertical.

P is on ink where the line crosses the +40 dashed grid line, on a locally straight stretch (slope 0.71 over v 3356 to 3372). The rise eases at a bend just below, corner about (1081,3378), 15 px from P; the rest of the easing is spread up to the crest near (1041,3276).

Line is vertical over v 3040 to 3150 (center 1068 to 1069.5). The dip at Q is a 2 px notch in the left edge only, not a turn visible on a 4x crop; load keeps falling with a pause. The real local minimum of load is near (1073,2975).

Same vertical stretch as item 004: the rebound at P is a 1 px shift of the right edge, not a local maximum visible on a 4x crop. Load falls from the crest at v 3270 through this pause to the minimum near (1073,2975).

Line runs vertical from v about 2330 to 2215 with 2 px edge bumps on alternating sides (center 1050.5 to 1052.5); no turn visible at Q on a 4x crop and no knee (the line approaches vertical gradually). Load falls from the maximum near v 2520 through this pause into the terminal descent.
Same vertical pause as item 006; the crest at P is a 2 px left-edge bump (v 2234 to 2260), not a local maximum visible on a 4x crop. The line keeps falling, with a pause, through the mark.

Gradual bend from vertical (v 2215) to a straight 32 degree descent (v 2105 and up). Q is on the bend but not at a corner: the later part of the bend (15 to 32 degrees) has its corner near (1071,2135), about 11 px from Q (fits give 9 to 14 px); the overall tangent corner is near (1060,2168), 24 px. Borderline.

Broad gradual steepening, about 22 degrees spread over v 2140 to 1920, no distinct corner; Q is about a third of the way through the turn. Corner estimates depend on the stretches fitted, from about (1530,2023) (6 px from Q) to (1542,1990) (40 px), so a corner within 8 px cannot be confirmed or ruled out.

P is on a straight stretch (dv/du 0.215 to 0.224 for u 2024 to 2080). The steepening the note describes is a 7 degree bend with its corner near (2112,3437), 41 px from P (a smaller step near (2089,3431) is 17 px away).

Return toward compression eases from about 28 to 10 degrees over v 2990 to 2870; curvature peaks at v 2910 to 2920, the angle midpoint is near (1996,2927) (8 px), and tangent-fit corners land 1 to 12 px from Q. Q on ink at the bend.

Unloading steepens through a broad bend from about 9 to 70 degrees from vertical (v 2276 to 2072); Q is at the middle of the turn, about 6 px from the point of the line nearest the tangent intersection, and curvature is highest at v 2130 to 2155.

Q is at the onset of the bend into the tail (about 5 to 10 degrees of a 50 degree turn). The corner of that bend (tangent intersection of the shallow stretch and the tail, apex on the line) is near (2160,2036), about 35 px from Q.

Fits to the clean edges of the stretches below and above the 0.03 s line put the 5 degree corner at about (1486,2803), 1 to 5 px from P; Q is at the grid-line crossing about 30 px further on, on the upper straight part. Fits that include the rows merged with the 2.0 in line are biased toward Q.

P is on ink where the line merges with the 4.0 in grid line. The measured kink there is only about 3 degrees (slope 0.25 to 0.20, corner near (951,1503)) and is not visible on a 4x crop; the visible rounding toward the flat top has its corner near v 1320 to 1365.

Line rounds from about 12 degrees (v 1420 to 1500) to the flat top (about 1 degree, v 1100 to 1180); the tangent intersection maps to (917,1323), 1 px from Q, and the angle midpoint is at v 1310 to 1325. Broad bend: fitting the 14.6 degree stretch below the small kink at v 1500 instead moves the corner to about (922,1363).

Q (1958,3507) is 5 px inside the t=0 line (v 3502 to 3512) at the near edge of the depth 0 line, so the ink under it is the grid crossing. The curve's own ink ends at v 3501 (u 1945 to 1957), about 6 px from Q, beyond the 2 px allowance.

The visible bend is the end of the vertical stretch at about (1344,2577), a 4 px jog to the left completed by v 2562; above it the line steepens only gradually (7 to 12 degrees over v 2550 to 2420). Q is 10 px above the end of the jog and 25 px from its corner; no corner within 8 px.
P is on a straight 12 degree stretch (v 2100 to 2300). The easing starts with a 3 to 4 degree step near (1245,2088), 19 px from P; the main rounding into the crest has its corner near (1235,2010).

Bend from about 21 to 62 degrees from vertical between v 3465 and 3436; corner (tangent fits and inner-edge turn) near (1757,3450), 13 to 15 px from P, which is on the upper end of the bend where the turn is nearly complete.

Recovery eases with a 12 degree bend; tangent corner at (1661,3160) (four fits within 1 px), 8 to 9 px from Q, which sits at the top of the bend on the near-vertical part. Right at the 8 px limit; judged at the knee.
P is on a steady 18 degree stretch (v 2960 to 3030). The easing is a 7 to 8 degree bend with its corner near (1620,2951), 12 px from P.
Line is vertical over v 2300 to 2520 within 0.5 px (center 1572.5 to 1573); no crest visible on a 4x crop. Load keeps rising slowly through the mark.
Same vertical stretch as item 023; the sag is a 1 px left-edge change (center shift 0.5 px), not a minimum visible on a 4x crop. Load keeps rising slowly through the mark.
Q is on the last ink of the line (free tip at v 1744), but the line is still rising (moving left, du/dv about 0.2) right up to the tip: an end of the record while still rising, not a local maximum.

Rounded bend from the shallow initial rise onto the run up the -40 lb grid line. The clean inner edge turns most sharply near (2126,3436), so the knee is near (2125,3437): P 3 px away, on curve ink right of the grid line (ink can be followed by thickness); Q 20 px back where the bend starts.
Rise eases from about 25 to 7 degrees; tangent fits put the corner at u 2069 to 2074, v 2942 to 2952, apex on the line near (2074,2948), within 1 to 7 px of Q, which is on ink.

Q (2264,3493) is on the top row of the t=0 line directly under the curve's last visible ink (a 1 px ledge at v 3492 for u 2259 to 2267), within 2 px of it and on the curve's extrapolated centerline, so it is the curve's first point by convention 2.
